scripts.serve: yarn clean && yarn build && tango serve
scripts.makemigrations: yarn clean && yarn build && tango makemigrations --app ./dist/apps/core/app.js --migrations-dir ./src/apps/core/migrations --name auto
scripts.migrate: yarn clean && yarn build && tango migrate --app ./dist/apps/core/app.js --migrations-dir ./dist/apps/core/migrations --database __PROJECT_DB_NAME__
scripts.check: yarn clean && yarn build && tango check --app ./dist/apps/core/app.js --migrations-dir ./src/apps/core/migrations
